action: Dusk. The pump from across the forecourt, lights fully on now against a deep blue sky, warm and welcoming and quietly busy. One car is filling. The dealer is a small calm figure near the office. The whole place looks like somewhere that is being run properly.
lighting: Deep blue evening sky against warm canopy and office light. The most inviting light in the film.
camera: Wide vertical. Clean open sky in the upper third for text in post. The canopy and forecourt fill the middle and lower frame. 35mm.
detail: Leave the upper third clean for a caption in post. The car has NO number plate, NO badges. NO signage, NO lettering, NO logos anywhere.
feeling: The closing image. Somewhere you would want your own pump to look like.
motion: Almost nothing moves. A very slow push in. Nothing enters or leaves frame, no doors open, nobody walks, nobody speaks.

voice_over.hi: जिसने ये वीडियो भेजा है, उन्हें जवाब दीजिए।
